name: @partneriq-io/browser
description: Official browser SDK for PartnerIQ: first-party referral capture and customer identification.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/index.mjs --format=esm --sourcemap && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2019 --outfile=dist/index.cjs --format=cjs --sourcemap && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=es2019 --format=iife --global-name=PartnerIQBrowser --minify --outfile=dist/partneriq.min.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test test/browser.test.mjs
